correctness.rationale: The proof is a direct mod-two reduction of the Debarre--Manivel coefficient formula. Endpoint factors force evenness when any degree is even; for all odd degrees each block becomes a pure monomial and the zero-dimensional condition fixes its exponent. The conjugation argument for the real corollary is standard and exact. The packaged exact checker reproduces benchmark counts and 209 admissible small cases.

value.rationale: The iff criterion gives a sharp structural boundary for a natural enumerative invariant and forces existence of a real line exactly at a zero-dimensional boundary missed by the classical strict-dimension theorem. It is not merely a table recomputation: the proof is uniform and applies to every admissible multidegree.
